newsitem.title: USA: Harvard Scientific to submit Phase I trial results.
newsitem.headline: Harvard Scientific to submit Phase I trial results.

text.p: Harvard Scientific Corp said Tuesday it would submit the results of Phase I clinical trials of its Prostaglandin-E1 erectile dysfunction treatment to the Food and Drug Administration and request approval to proceed with the second phase of testing early next year.
The Phase I testing exceeded the company's expectations, Harvard Scientific said.
It also said it has made progress in obtaining strategic partners who will market the product world-wide.
The company said it knows no reason for the recent decline in its share price.

"We have no explanation for the recent lack of support for our stock. The company and the progress of our erectile dysfunction product are stronger than at any time since we began public trading," it said.
Harvard Scientific's stock closed at 31/32 on Monday.
